AKTA PENCEGAHAN PENGUBAHAN WANG HARAM,
PENCEGAHAN PEMBIAYAAN KEGANASAN DAN HASIL
DARIPADA AKTIVITI HARAM 2001

PERINTAH PENCEGAHAN PENGUBAHAN WANG HARAM, PENCEGAHAN
PEMBIAYAAN KEGANASAN DAN HASIL DARIPADA AKTIVITI HARAM
(PENGGUNAAN Bahagian IV) 2017

Papa menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh subseksyen 8(1) Akta Pencegahan
Pengubahan Wang Haram, Pencegahan Pembiayaan Keganasan dan Hasil
daripada Aktiviti Haram 2001 (Akta 613), Menteri Kewangan, atas syor pihak
berkuasa berwibawa, membuat perintah yang berikut:

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pencegahan Pengubahan
Wang Haram, Pencegahan Pembiayaan Keganasan dan Hasil daripada

Aktiviti Haram (Penggunaan Bahagian IV) 2017.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Januari 2018.

P.U. (A) 424.                                     6904

Penggunaan Bahagian IV Akta

2. Peruntukan Bahagian IV Akta hendaklah digunakan ke atas mana-mana
institusi pelapor yang menjalankan apa-apa aktiviti yang dinyatakan dalam
perenggan 25 Jadual Pertama Akta.

ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING, ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING AND
PROCEEDS OF UNLAWFUL ACTIVITIES ACT 2001

ANTI-MoNEY LAUNDERING, ANTI-TERRORISM FINANCING AND PROCEEDS OF
UNLAWFUL ACTIVITIES (INVOCATION OF Part IV) Order 2017

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 8(1) of the Anti-Money
Laundering, Anti-Terrorism Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful Activities
Act 2001 [Act 6/3], the Minister of Finance, upon the recommendation of
the competent authority, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorism
Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful Activities (Invocation of Part IV)

Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 2 January 2018.

Invocation of Part IV of Act

2. The provisions of Part IV of the Act shall be invoked on any reporting
institution carrying out any activity specified in paragraph 25 of the First
Schedule of the Act.

Made 26 December 2017
[BNM.JUN 1125/3603; KK/SID/P/(S)/382/783/1 JLD. 14 (SK. 5);
